sources.snippet: Estragon-9B is the one that stopped waiting: a fine-tune of Qwen3.5-9B into a Godot 4.7 / GDScript specialist — a solo project on a ~$100 compute budget (RunPod rentals + Claude API for synthetic data), benchmarked with a verifiable eval harness (headless Godot as judge), and released as GGUF.
